lines.text: Many learners say: I will bring you to the station.
Better: I will take you to the station.
Take goes away from here. Bring comes here.
Take! I will take you to the station.

data.wrong: I will bring you to the station.
data.right: I will take you to the station.
data.why: Take goes away from here. Bring comes here.
data.memory: I will take you to the station.

native.tip: 離れた場所へ連れていくときは take。bring は自分のところへ持ってくるとき。
native.caption: “I will bring you to the station.”と言っていませんか？😅 「連れていく」を bring と訳しがちです。“I will take you to the station.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“take”。同じ形で自分の文を1つ書いてみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: Going away from here, use take.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I will bring you to the station.” 😅 Use take for going away from here. The natural way is “I will take you to the station.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
